text:
Radioactive materials must be handled in a safe way.
What is not a safety procedure?
A
storing radioactive materials in cardboard boxes
B
monitoring exposure time to radioactive materials
C
using tongs to pick up the radioactive source
D
wearing protective clothing

options.label: A
options.text: storing radioactive materials in cardboard boxes

options.text: monitoring exposure time to radioactive materials
